chronology: Post-review descriptive extension designed with prior results known. Rules fixed before inspecting new amount/screening and discrepancy concentration summaries. Not project-wide preregistration or blind validation.

amount.precision: round-trip input parsing; original unrounded values for amount statistics

screening.threshold_rule: For n units, k=ceil(q*n); cutoff is kth largest rounded score; include every unit at or above cutoff. Never break ties arbitrarily.
screening.all_zero: Include all units and explicitly flag no discrimination. Report actual selection fractions and ties, including all-zero strata.
screening.pooling: Sum counts over fixed disjoint strata; denominator remains original A or R. Report layer summaries separately.
metrics: signed D30/absolute D30 summaries within discrepant selected groups
screening.interpretation: Observed input sensitivity on identical local tasks. Not truth accuracy, bills, savings, user choice, demand response or flexible-load ranking.

events: E/T labels unequal at common kappa=0.03 on A
primary screening symmetric difference on A
report: remaining rate after top-k contributors excluded
concentration.interpretation: Post-observation descriptive concentration; exclusions are sensitivity summaries, not new primary samples.
